hypothesis: hypothesis.md: completed D/W structure agreement, M15 and H1 entries
baseline: no_htf_h1 fixed control; prior no_htf_baseline M15 results as reference
higher_timeframe_rules: D1 source00:00 and W1 sourceMonday00:00 observed OHLC, ended periods only, entry bar OPEN lookup, both directions equal/nonzero and both pivots present
entry_rules: hypothesis.md; left2/right2 confirmed consumed-pivot close break; prebar opposite pivot +/-1tick stop; exact raw-M1 next contiguous open

exit_rules.fill_model: unchanged imported prior audited simulator; see hypothesis.md

r_diagnostic_execution: independent period position initialization and terminal mark, matching old M15 baseline; JPY accounts stay fully continuous without reset
monthly_additional_diagnostics: longest consecutive months failing 5 percent including undefined months; all cases including control C get account gate diagnostics
final_confirmation: NOT_PERFORMED: all periods previously viewed, no pristine holdout
final_period_prior_exposure: Repeated prior studies and rejected H1/H4 study; descriptive only

acceptance_gates.comparison_mean_r: B >= same H1 control and A >= saved M15 control, each later period, 3-symbol equal-R trades

cross_symbol_rule: Each later period at least 2/3 symbols normal PF_R>=1.2, mean_net_R>0 and trades>=100

metric_edge_definitions.comparison_mean_r: sum netR across all 3 symbols / sum trade counts
metric_edge_definitions.zero_loss_pf: undefined null including no trades; minimum PF gate fails
metric_edge_definitions.nonpositive_equity: nonpositive starting equity gives undefined month return; any undefined or <=-100% monthly return makes geometric/arithmetic/median undefined and gate fails
metric_edge_definitions.stopped_before_period: never_stopped gate fails for every later period
metric_edge_definitions.h1_execution_mapping: 10-11 completed H1 signal occupies 10:45 M15 slot and is consumed only at 11:00 next-open
